newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq continues climb, scores another record.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq continues climb, scores another record.

text.p: Large capitalization technology stocks that powered November's Nasdaq market's climb remained at full throttle Monday, December's first trading session, resulting in another record high in mixed trade.
The Nasdaq composite added 7.2 points, or 0.56 percent, to close unoffically at 1299.8, the broad measures's sixth consecutive record high.
But declining issues outpaced gainers by 2328 to 1985, and 957 shares were unchanged. The day yielded 168 new highs and 116 new lows on unofficial volume of 527 million shares.

"It was all the usual suspects again with another strong day in the big Nasdaqs (stocks)," said Brian Finnerty, Unterberg Harris managing director. "It was definitely buying in the tech sector again," he said.
Most-active Informix Corp gained on the expectation of a new generation of database management software that may eclipse that of rival Oracle Corp.
Informix finshed up 2-5/8 at 26-3/8 while Oracle gained 5/8 to 49-5/8.
Atmel Corp added 2-3/4 at 35-5/8, Medaphis Corp soared 2-1/8 at 12-1/2 and U.S. Robotics extended last week's ascent with a 2-1/8 rise to 80-7/8.
